name: Hearthsmoke Vale
description: Act 1, the Vell heartland (E4 Smoke on the Horizon, E5 The Keeper's Song). A wide green vale with a shallow stream bed across it and two Vell camps: the main village in the north-west and the song-keeper's camp by a stone circle in the north-east (`keeper-stones`). In the south-east lies a burnt field round an old hull: a precursor colony "burned from above" (`burned-field`, the sky-fire story told in ground). Few predators. The richest deposit sits on Vell land: the temptation. Suggested hooks: `vale-smoke` when the scouts first see the smoke, a Keeper story at `keeper-stones` after trust, and a dig at `burned-field`.

sites.label: Burnt field and hull: sky-fire (E5 clue)
